registration: question + background + design + bars + parity block frozen VERBATIM from the dispatch letter (the substrate program's first GPU cell; the owner's 2026-10-12 directive); this script committed at birth BEFORE any compute; adjudicate against exactly this; no bar shopping.

registered.question_verbatim: is the grammar the training dynamics' (transport-invariant) or AdamW's? YOUR CELL: the first cross. (THE OPTIMIZER CROSS — the substrate program's first GPU cell)
registered.background_verbatim: every law this lab has measured was measured under AdamW on one 2.74M architecture with one CE loss — Law 1 (every death is a step-death), Law 2b's kill bracket [0.0008, 0.004] of write norm, the formation texture (the wheel, the net0 classes), the seat grammar (maintenance, capacity). NONE has ever been crossed against a different optimizer.
registered.design_verbatim: 1. THE OPTIMIZER SET: SGD (no momentum, no adaptivity — the pure geometry), momentum-SGD (0.9), RMSProp (adaptive but no moment terms), and SIGN-DESCENT (the extreme: pure direction, magnitude-normalized — the lab's own simplest custom optimizer). Per-optimizer lr sweeps at birth (a coarse 5-point ladder each, the canon formation at the standard dose; the lr that lands in the canon's read band becomes that optimizer's canonical lr — the DOSE NORMALIZATION, pre-registered). 2. THE FORMATION TEXTURE: the canon name's formation under each optimizer at its canonical lr — the read trajectory, the write norm, the in-room fraction, the s1 behavior (the wheel? the classes?), vs the committed AdamW record. 3. THE KILL BRACKET: Law 2b's two boundary rungs (the 0.0008x and 0.004x transport-kills) re-run under each optimizer in ITS canonical-lr terms (the drift-realization disclosed) — does the bracket MOVE (per-optimizer renormalized) or HOLD? 4. THE MAINTENANCE PROBE: the tonly/conly split (x57's role split — the cheapest seat probe: does attention-only protect under each optimizer?)

bars_verbatim.TRANSPORT-INVARIANT: the laws hold under every optimizer at its canonical lr (the formation texture within the disclosed band; the bracket within 2x after lr-normalization; maintenance attention-side throughout) — the grammar is the loss-geometry's.
bars_verbatim.OPTIMIZER-SPECIFIC: which laws move first (the texture? the bracket? the maintenance?) — named per optimizer; the grammar re-scopes to AdamW-class dynamics.
bars_verbatim.MIXED: some hold, some move — the honest split, itemized.

parity_block_verbatim.LAB_LEAN: OPTIMIZER-SPECIFIC, moderately (the adaptive vs non-adaptive step geometry differs hugely; the bracket especially should move — it is measured in write-norm units that mean different things per optimizer)
parity_block_verbatim.COUNTER: TRANSPORT-INVARIANT (the loss geometry dominates; the optimizer is a solver, and solvers converge to the same minima basin)

optimizer_set.SGD: torch.optim.SGD, lr only — the pure geometry
optimizer_set.RMSPROP: torch.optim.RMSprop alpha=0.99 eps=1e-08 momentum=0 centered=False — adaptive, NO moment terms
optimizer_set.SIGN: THIS CELL'S OWN minimal custom optimizer (stated per the dispatch): update = p -= lr*sign(grad); NO state, NO moments, NO adaptivity — pure direction, magnitude-normalized
optimizer_set.ADAMW: the committed canon class — the in-session ANCHOR arm + the P4 reference pair, never a law-carrier
optimizer_set.decay_channel: crossed arms carry the committed per-step decoupled decay velocity (1 - 1e-4 x cosine_t) post-step (built-ins wd=0); ADAMW uses the built-in wd 0.1 (bit-faithful)

canonical_lr_rule: the ladder run whose post-install g0 lands in the canon read band [0.15, 0.45]; multiple in-band -> the g0 closest to 0.26464763283729553; none in-band -> min |log(g0/0.2646...)| with the miss disclosed
